articles.title: Ramp in talks to hit $40B+ valuation, 6 months after reaching $32B
articles.summary: The company is reportedly in talks to raise another $750 million at a pre-money valuation of more than $40 billion. It last raised in November at $32 billion.

articles.title: OpenAI launches new voice intelligence features in its API
articles.summary: The new features could be handy for customer service systems, but OpenAI says they have applications that work across a variety of other fields, including education and creator platforms.

articles.title: Kodiak AI raises $100M at a steep discount, sending its stock tumbling 37%
articles.summary: The company made a series of other announcements during earnings, including a new commercial contract, a pilot program in Canada, and a collaboration.

articles.title: Voi founders’ new AI startup Pit has become the latest rising star out of Stockholm
articles.summary: AI startup Pit is led by the co-founders of European scooter giant Voi and backed by a16z, which is leading the startup’s $16 million seed round.

articles.title: Hackers deface school login pages after claiming another Instructure hack

articles.title: Tesla Model Y is first car to meet new US driver assistance safety benchmark
articles.summary: The new benchmark rating applies to 2026 Tesla Model Y vehicles assembled on or after November 12, 2025.

articles.summary: Perplexity's Personal Computer brings AI agents to your Mac, and is now open to everyone.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s lawsuit is putting OpenAI’s safety record under the microscope

articles.title: Bumble is getting rid of the swipe, CEO says
articles.summary: Based on Whitney Wolfe Herd's past comments about Bumble's new direction, the company is expected to lean into AI -- Bumble is even working on an AI dating assistant called Bee, and the CEO has made many comments over the years about how AI will be "a supercharger to love and relationships."

articles.title: Could Lovable’s automatic 10% pay raise be the cure for toxic cultures?
